en_US.title: Black Keel Approach Packet
en_US.scanner: Approach buffer recovered. Contract active; rescue reserve conditional.
en_US.field_note: Carrier invoice before comfort. If Black Keel says claimant, it is counting mass before it counts pulse.
en_US.terminal: BLACK KEEL APPROACH / CLAIMANT: ACTIVE / DESCENT WINDOW: BILLED / RETURN MASS: HOLD PENDING WEATHER, PROOF, LIEN 4.8 TONNE-WINDOW.
en_US.audio: Black Keel tender to claimant. Descent window billed. Return conditional. Four-point-eight tonne-window lien open.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Recovered approach packets show Black Keel as claim-pool infrastructure: useful, dry and bound to mass-through-window debt before rescue language.
en_US.external_site: Black Keel opens HECTON-8 with contract pressure. The call sounds procedural because the carrier measures a claim before it measures a person.

en_US.title: Drop Capsule Diagnostic Readout
en_US.scanner: Capsule diagnostic still polls failed ascent hardware.
en_US.field_note: Flood behind panel C. Guidance strip clicked twice, then stayed red. Keep the heat tile; the screen marks it as scrap, but the seal line still bites.
en_US.terminal: BATHY-DROP DIAG 00: ascent bus unavailable; gimbal lock; relay mast shear; compressor flood; heat tile reserve local only.
en_US.audio: Ascent bus dark. Gimbal locked. Relay gone. Compressor flooded.
en_US.in_game_wiki: The diagnostic readout makes the crash a repair chain: ascent, guidance, relay, compression and heat protection all failed in named hardware.
en_US.external_site: HECTON-8 blocks escape through broken machinery, not fogged plot logic. The capsule can still diagnose the systems it can no longer move.

en_US.title: P-63 Pump Room First Repair Task
en_US.scanner: Pump-room task card recovered. Pressure work comes before salvage.
en_US.field_note: Do not cut while the seam sings. Pump until the floor stops pushing back, patch the cold line, then mark the door with the pinger.
en_US.terminal: WORK ORDER P-63: manual pump cycle; cold seam patch; fused latch cut; acoustic return line; gasket print after pressure holds.
en_US.audio: Pump first. Patch cold. Cut only when the seam goes quiet.
en_US.in_game_wiki: P-63 task cards turn the first shelter into labor: water out, seal closed, route marked, gasket printed.
en_US.external_site: The first repair in HECTON-8 is a wet work order. Tools matter because every dry room has to be argued back from the ocean.
